newsitem.title: USA: Union Acceptance unit sets securitization.
newsitem.headline: Union Acceptance unit sets securitization.

text.p: Union Acceptance Corp said Friday its subsidiary, UAC Securitization Corp, has agreed to place about $293 million of asset-backed securities, representing interests in a pool of prime automobile loans.

The securitization is structured as a multiple-class auto trust. The certificates to be issued by the Trust will be credit- enhanced by an irrevocable surety bond provided by Capital Markets Assurance Corp and are expected to be rated triple-A and Aaa by Standard & Poor s Ratings Group and Moody s Investor Service, respectively.
The lead manager and co-manager of the transaction are NationsBanc Capital Markets Inc and Goldman, Sachs & Co., respectively.
The weighted average rate was about 13.29 percent and the coupon cost to the investor was about 6.32 percent, giving UAC a gross spread of 6.97 percent.

The transaction is expected to close February 18, 1997. Including the UACSC 1997-A Auto Trust, UAC and its affiliates have securitized about $4.1 billion in prime auto loans and about $65.6 million in non-prime auto loans since 1988.

UAC is a specialized finance company which acquires and services prime automobile retail installment sales contracts originated by dealerships affiliated with major domestic and foreign manufacturers.
